label: Nectanebo I's walls and the First Pylon
more: Nectanebo I (reigned 380 to 362 BC) ringed the Amun-Ra temple with a mud-brick wall about 21 metres high and began the First Pylon as its grand western gate. He never finished it, and the builders' mud-brick ramp still stands behind it.

label: Avenue of Sphinxes reopens to Luxor
more: On 25 November 2021 Egypt held a televised ceremony to reopen the restored avenue of about 2.7 kilometres linking Karnak and Luxor Temple, after decades of excavation. Most of its sphinxes belong to Nectanebo I. It was the processional road of the Opet festival.
